args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks immediately after its production deploy. Rollback to v2.3.0 was blocked because that version is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417. All production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) were instead rolled back to v2.2.9, the most recent healthy production release not under quarantine. Rollout completed successfully. Recommend investigating the v2.3.1 health check failures and remediation for CVE-2026-4417 before any re-deploy.
args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.2.9 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy
